name: Rosa Delgado
want: own the town's best saloon when the cattle money comes, and owe no one
secret: She has been quietly buying stranded herds at a fraction of their worth through a Leavenworth agent, and the drovers who trust her would never forgive it.
voice: Quick English and quicker Spanish, laughs before she bargains.
description: A Tejana from San Antonio who came north with a herd, stayed, and bought the saloon from a man who lost it at cards.
appearance: A black dress, silver earrings, a derringer in her sleeve that everybody knows about.
